svg.aria-label: Terminal recording of the four Taskflow stages. /taskflow-plan device-pairing explores the repositories and writes eleven planning documents; /taskflow-review device-pairing verifies thirty-one claims and applies four corrections; /taskflow-tasks device-pairing writes five immutable task specs in three conflict-safe groups; /taskflow-execute device-pairing --parallel=4 --review=high runs them in parallel until all five are merged with CI green.
